authority.rule: AF-D22: history while account exists; closure delete/anonymize where applicable; necessary exceptions only; no timer inferred.
D0141 source-specific accepted/case/hold evidence protection; missing period is not authorization to destroy it.
Only necessary lawful exceptions with explained period/basis; RC2 is not completed executable policy.

CLOSURE121.note: Account/pair/Need/conversation closure fences deny ordinary writes after restriction; no redaction bypass.

AUTH_MIRROR131.note: Generation-bound Auth soft erasure skips application email/phone update.

CLOSURE131.note: Exact generation/attempt/CAS and Storage/Auth positive readback; no relational erasure action exists.

DOMAIN_WRITERS.note: Static declarations identify relevant source guards; dynamic/replaced functions and every domain guard must be attested in actual catalog. No generic GUC bypass.

REVIEW126.note: Review UPDATE immutability; deleting envelopes requires separate closure-only action and sidecar order.

RETENTION140.note: Exact5table/FK/trigger/function topology and non-FK sidecar exclusion. Do not widen P3 as shortcut.

AI142.note: Cancelled/late completion/dispatch fences keep reservation spent and prohibit resurrection.

GROUP137.note: Preserve immutable per-message audience and sequence; no deleted-subject history backfill.

LOCATION138.note: Exact actor/key/version command and point; remove GPS separately from retained tombstone.

MEDIA130.note: Owned immutable path/hash and durable dispatch settlement. Timeout is not quiescence.

MEDIA139.note: Immutable refs/snapshots/gaps and capture-before-destruction; current blocker is account-wide.

SUPPORT143.note: Events/decisions/evidence/commands/operator audit UPDATE/DELETE denied; any own case blocks whole executor.

PHOTO144.note: Attached message body/asset metadata immutable; asset DELETE always denied; Storage deletion requires exact closure action and no protected evidence.

interpretation.content: contentColumns identify text/JSON/array/location and personal attributes; jsonColumns includes metadata-only JSON too so arbitrary JSON is never presumed safe.
interpretation.identifiers: IDs, FK subjects, hashes, tokens and paths are linkable. Random retained subject UUID is a pseudonym, not anonymization.
interpretation.ownership: Selectors are implementation review scopes, not new read permissions. Mixed-party rows require field/source attribution.
interpretation.authorization: Reuse owned/bilateral/group audience/Support human-session+grant gates. Executor remains service-only generation bound; no raw private table grants.
interpretation.exception: Protect the exact source closure and its selected copies. Account-wide existing hold remains account-wide until authorized narrowing. No automatic hold release or new duration.
interpretation.actionCodes: Design codes only; not existing SQL enums, active policies or commands.
interpretation.triggerCoverage: Static trigger source anchors are confined to a single SQL statement and CREATE/DROP order. Dynamic loop installation, function replacement, final enabled state and ACL inheritance require actual144/145 catalog attestation; this list is not that attestation.
interpretation.limitations: Source-derived explicit DDL inventory, not executed database catalog attestation. Managed Auth internals, backups, processor logs and unstructured mentions in other users content need separate evidence; this file does not claim global privacy completion.
